site.featured_research.finding_en: Constraining Earth system models with river flow from 50 large basins puts global river flow at 39.1 ± 5.4 × 10³ km³ per year, lower than most earlier estimates, and updates the textbook diagram of the global water cycle.
site.featured_research.finding_zh: 结合全球 50 条大型河流的实测径流约束地球系统模型，将全球河川流量修正为 39.1 ± 5.4 × 10³ km³/年，低于以往多数估计，并更新了经典的全球水循环示意图。

site.featured_research.finding_en: Projections constrained by observations indicate that future declines in global streamflow are probably more severe than previously estimated.
site.featured_research.finding_zh: 基于观测约束的预估表明，未来全球径流减少可能比以往估计的更为严重。

site.featured_research.finding_en: Satellite and ground observations show that the decline in global land water availability over the past two decades was concentrated in the Southern Hemisphere.
site.featured_research.finding_zh: 结合卫星与地面观测，揭示近二十年全球陆地水资源可用性的下降主要集中在南半球。

site.featured_research.finding_en: Observations from 183 large basins reveal opposing evapotranspiration trends in the Northern and Southern Hemispheres during 2000–2022.
site.featured_research.finding_zh: 结合全球 183 个大型流域的水文观测，揭示 2000—2022 年北半球蒸散发增加、南半球蒸散发下降的相反趋势。

site.featured_research.finding_en: Satellite observations of 468 severe drought events show that recovery of basin water storage depends on water availability, recurring drought and human water use.
site.featured_research.finding_zh: 基于 468 次严重干旱事件的卫星观测，揭示旱后水分可利用性、干旱反复发生与人类用水压力对流域水储量恢复的影响。

site.featured_research.finding_en: CAS-Canglong, a 3D Swin Transformer, predicts global sea surface temperature at 0.25° resolution, with forecast lead times up to 16 months.
site.featured_research.finding_zh: “中科苍龙”基于三维 Swin Transformer，在 0.25° 分辨率下开展全球海温预报，最长预报提前期可达 16 个月。

site.featured_research.finding_en: The direct response of vegetation to the recent rise in CO₂ has had only a limited effect on global streamflow.
site.featured_research.finding_zh: 近期 CO₂ 浓度上升引起的植被直接响应对全球径流的影响有限。

site.pi.title_en: Senior Research Fellow (Grade II), Hydrology and Water Resources
site.pi.title_zh: 二级研究员，水文与水资源
bio_en: Dr. Yongqiang Zhang is a Senior Research Fellow (Grade II) in Hydrology and Water Resources at the Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences, and Deputy Director of the Key Laboratory of Land Water Cycle and Surface Processes. He is a Foreign Member of the European Academy of Sciences (elected 2026) and a National Leading Talent in Scientific and Technological Innovation. Professor Zhang is a Fellow of the Modelling and Simulation Society of Australia and New Zealand and an Alexander von Humboldt Fellow (Germany). He chairs the Hydrological Geography Professional Committee of the Geographical Society of China, heads the Hydrometeorology Division of the International Modelling and Simulation Society, and is an appointed Chinese expert for the World Meteorological Organization. In addition, Professor Zhang serves on the editorial boards of five major international journals, including Journal of Geophysical Research: Atmospheres, Journal of Hydrology, and Remote Sensing of Environment. Over the past five years, he has led seven key research projects, including grants from the National Key Research and Development Program, a key project of the National Natural Science Foundation, and the Talent Program of the Chinese Academy of Sciences. In 2026, he received the AGU Joanne Simpson Medal and became an AGU Fellow.

Professor Zhang has devoted his career to large scale hydrology, with a special focus on evapotranspiration mechanisms and their eco-hydrological effects. He has published 280 papers in peer-reviewed journals, including prestigious titles such as Science, Nature Geoscience, and Nature Water. In the past five years alone, he has authored or co-authored 70 papers as first or corresponding author in top-tier journals. His research has been cited ~27,000 times, and he has an H-index of 78. His most cited first-authored paper has accumulated over 1,000 citations. In addition, Professor Zhang has 13 ESI Highly Cited Papers and has been recognized as an Elsevier Highly Cited Chinese Researcher for five consecutive years.

The team led by Professor Zhang comprises professors, associate professors, postdoc fellows, doctoral candidates, and master's students, totaling about 30 members. Students in the team come mainly from top-tier Chinese universities, including Tsinghua University, the University of Science and Technology of China, Beijing Normal University, and Hohai University. The team actively collaborates with top researchers both in China and abroad and has established long-term academic partnerships with internationally renowned institutions, including Ghent University, Vienna University of Technology, Pacific Northwest National Laboratory in the United States, and the Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO) in Australia.

Under Professor Zhang's supervision, students and young researchers from both China and abroad have thrived in a dynamic, interdisciplinary research environment. Domestically, team members regularly present at major national conferences and have received numerous awards for young scientists. International students and visiting scholars contribute diverse perspectives, with many going on to secure positions at leading global institutions. This cultivation of next-generation talent underscores the team's lasting impact on the hydrological sciences worldwide.
bio_zh: 张永强研究员是中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所水文与水资源学科二级研究员，同时担任陆地水循环及地表过程重点实验室副主任。他是欧洲科学院外籍院士（2026 年当选）、国家科技创新领军人才、澳大利亚和新西兰模型模拟学会会士和德国洪堡学者，现任中国地理学会水文地理专业委员会主任、国际模型模拟学会水文气象部主席，并受聘为世界气象组织中国专家。此外，张永强研究员还担任五个主要国际期刊的编委，包括Journal of Geophysical Research: Atmospheres、Journal of Hydrology和Remote Sensing of Environment。在过去五年中，他主持了七个重点科研项目，包括国家重点研发计划、国家自然科学基金重点项目和中国科学院人才计划等。2026 年，张永强研究员荣获 AGU Joanne Simpson 奖章并当选 AGU 会士。

张永强研究员致力于大尺度水文学研究，特别关注蒸散发机制及其生态水文效应。他在同行评审期刊上发表了280篇论文，包括Science、Nature Geoscience和Nature Water等著名期刊。仅在过去五年，他就以第一作者或通讯作者身份在顶级期刊发表了70篇论文。他的研究已被引用约27,000次，H指数为78。他的被引次数最多的第一作者论文累计引用超过1,000次。此外，张永强研究员拥有13篇ESI高被引论文，并连续五年被评为爱思唯尔中国高被引学者。
张永强研究员领导的团队由教授、副教授、博士后、博士研究生和硕士研究生组成，共有约30名成员。团队学生主要来自清华大学、中国科学技术大学、北京师范大学和河海大学等国内一流高校。团队积极与国内外顶尖研究人员合作，并与国际知名机构建立了长期学术合作关系，包括根特大学、维也纳工业大学、美国西北太平洋国家实验室和澳大利亚联邦科学与工业研究组织（CSIRO）。
在张永强研究员的指导下，来自中国和国外的学生和青年研究人员在一个充满活力的跨学科研究环境中茁壮成长。在国内，团队成员定期在主要的全国性会议上发表演讲，并获得了众多青年科学家奖项。国际学生和访问学者贡献了多元化的视角，许多人随后在全球领先机构获得了职位。这种对下一代人才的培养凸显了该团队对全球水文科学的持久影响。

If you are interested in research topics related to water, climate, hydrology, natural resources and natural disasters, and you also happen to love hydrological modelling, big data analysis, machine learning, data science or simply programming and algorithm development, we have MPhil/PhD Student and Postdoc Researcher positions available in our group.
